# BookYourSlot

> BookYourSlot (bookyourslot.online) is a self-hosted scheduling platform. People and teams create
> booking pages backed by real availability rules; guests pick a time in their own time zone and
> everyone gets automatic email confirmations. Free during early access.

## What it does

- Booking pages: every person and team gets a public page (bookyourslot.online/username) where
  guests book themselves.
- Availability and time zones: working hours, date overrides, buffers; slots shown in the guest's
  time zone automatically.
- Team scheduling: round-robin events (bookings distributed across members) and collective events
  (all members attend), respecting individual availability.
- Google Calendar sync: two-way — busy times block the page, new bookings are written to the calendar.
- Email confirmations and reminders for bookings, reschedules, and cancellations.
- Embeds, API and webhooks for integrating booking flows into other sites and automations.

BookYourSlot does not currently offer built-in video conferencing or payment collection.
